mechanism.claim: A sign transition in the same-session HYG-minus-LQD return changes the traded corporate-credit risk-appetite regime rather than merely extending a level. During elevated BTC variation, follow the new credit-quality direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of current HYG log return minus current LQD log return after an opposite prior source-valid sign
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCREDIT trades every high-variation credit-relative level and failed Gross9. HVCQTR trades only polarity transitions between consecutive frozen credit sessions, forming a new event topology. It uses no HVCREDIT event set/control, equity return, Treasury price, crypto direction, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular external credit-quality polarity transitions are sparser than the terminal level clock

features.relative_credit_return: log(HYG close/open)-log(LQD close/open), finite strict nonzero
features.previous: immediately prior source-valid shared cash session in frozen chronological order
features.transition: current and previous relative returns have strict opposite signs

clock.reservation: chronological half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after Gross9

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no assets, return, previous-session law, transition, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
